t: The Lexco Alrai single 5ft LED CCT Batten is an integrated lighting solution designed for robust performance in demanding environments. This non-dimmable LED batten is ideal for commercial and industrial applications, including warehouses, workshops, and factories, providing reliable illumination. Featuring an IP65 rating for dust and water jet protection and an IK08 impact rating, it ensures durability. Installation is streamlined with a multi-entry exit point system and UK BESA box compatibility. Users can adjust the colour temperature from warm white to daylight white, offering versatile lighting options. It is also linkable with a loop in/loop out system for larger installations.
